messages:
nina_support: FYI — customer in EU reporting ~300ms tail latency and occasional auth failures. They say requests are being sent to us-west.

michael_h: do we have their request/response headers and a trace id?

nina_support: pasted what they sent:

curl -v -H 'Host: api.redwood.com' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'X-Client-Region: eu-west-1' 'https://gateway.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=...'

Response headers (customer):
x-served-region: us-west-2
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 118
x-request-id: req-189012-A1B2

They also reported 401s on the misrouted calls.

eli_ops: we rolled a fallback policy change last Thursday. @michael_h could be related. Can you check the L7 route header matching / rewrite logic?

sara_k: quick repro I did: send 100 requests with X-Client-Region: eu-west-1. 5% of requests get routed to us-west-2 and return 401. I can share logs.

nina_support: logs (redacted):
[2026-02-12T12:03:44Z] req=req-189012-A1B2 headers: { 'x-client-region': 'eu-west-1', 'host': 'api.redwood.com' } -> route matched: api-route -> upstream: us-west-pool
[2026-02-12T12:03:44Z] fallback_policy: ['PRIMARY','GLOBAL_US']

eli_ops: hm, route's fallback looks wrong. It should be ['PRIMARY','GLOBAL_EU','GLOBAL'] for EU clients. Seems like the fallback map is resolving to GLOBAL_US. Possible causes: header normalization bug or fallback table key mismatch.

michael_h: I can reproduce locally. Observed that when header case is mixed (X-Client-Region vs x-client-region) a small percentage hits the old fallback. Looks like the new routing lookup is doing a case-sensitive map lookup against the header name instead of normalized keys.

nina_support: envoy route snippet from cluster config:
```
route:
  name: api-route
  request_headers_to_add:
    - header:
        key: x-client-region
        value: "%DYNAMIC_REGION%"
```

eli_ops: ok — the runtime expects header keys normalized to lower-case, but the fallback-codepath was comparing against the original header name returned by an upstream plugin. Edge case triggered under high concurrency.

michael_h: I'll push a patch to normalize header keys before fallback lookup and add a unit test for mixed-case headers. Short-term mitigation: we can add a header rewrite at the gateway to force X-Region-Override: eu-west-1 for EU routes.

deploy-bot: deploy/patch-495 started: normalize-header-keys -> canary (eng-runtime)

sara_k: canary looks clean — 0/1000 misroutes in canary region after patch.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: patch-495 -> production at 2026-02-12T12:45:10Z

nina_support: Customer confirmed: requests now consistently served from eu-west and auth 200s restored. Closing the escal.

michael_h: Followup: created issue #833 in eng-runtime to add integration test with our gateway and update docs about header casing. Will monitor for next 48h.
